360 Political Ecology (360PE) communicates research evidence through accessible formats while preserving links to original sources, uncertainty, and the distinction between documented findings and interpretation.

**Media & Dialogues is being established.** No videos, interviews, podcasts, or social media releases are listed as published until their source records and public URLs have been verified.

## How our media connects to research

Every released 360PE media product will identify its related [360PE Review](publications.qmd) publication or supporting evidence, its research [topic](topics.qmd), and its publication date. Where applicable, we will provide transcripts, source notes, and corrections.

## Participate responsibly

We welcome constructive research questions, corrections, and collaboration proposals through our [Contact page](contact.qmd). External social channels will be linked here only after their official ownership and destinations have been confirmed.

360PE is an independent, research-informed publication and analytical platform. Media published by 360PE does not imply independent external academic peer review.
